mechanism: Establish two visually distinct roles at different depths, let the nearer role trigger a continuous exchange whose shared contact height rises in readable stages from ground to one joint aerial apex, then return both roles to a grounded held relationship without inventing a winner.

invariants.rule: Establish two stable roles and a readable depth or distance gap before contact.
invariants.purpose: Makes the initiating commitment and later convergence legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting in a tangled exchange removes the baseline and makes escalation hard to read.

invariants.rule: Use one committed approach to create the first low shared contact state.
invariants.purpose: Provides a measurable contact baseline rather than random action.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the first event has no shared contact, later height changes have no reference point.

invariants.rule: Raise contact amplitude or altitude through at least one intermediate exchange while role identity stays stable.
invariants.purpose: Turns repetition into a visible escalation ladder.
invariants.ablation_failure: Contacts at one unchanged height feel repetitive rather than progressive.

invariants.rule: Reserve one shared airborne or otherwise clearly highest joint event as the apex.
invariants.purpose: Gives the ladder a single unmistakable peak.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several equal peaks flatten the hierarchy and dilute the climax.

invariants.rule: Return both roles to a grounded or baseline plane and hold their post-apex relationship without asserting an unsupported result.
invariants.purpose: Closes the height arc and preserves source uncertainty.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending during the apex feels truncated; declaring a winner invents evidence.

slots.name: role_pair
slots.constraint: Two original stable roles with visibly distinct silhouettes or functions.

slots.name: initial_gap
slots.constraint: A readable depth, distance or level separation before the first shared action.

slots.name: contact_carrier
slots.constraint: One original object, signal or task that both roles visibly affect.

slots.name: height_ladder
slots.constraint: At least low, intermediate and peak shared states with continuous causal handoffs.

slots.name: apex_realization
slots.constraint: One unmistakably highest joint event, not repeated spectacle.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: Proof-oriented framing that compares the baseline, intermediate rise, apex and return.

slots.name: end_relationship
slots.constraint: A held post-apex relationship that does not claim an unsupported winner or diagnosis.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: Original story-world cues that distinguish low, rising, apex and settling phases.

anti_copy_exclusions: two fantasy women in black and white dresses
moonlit cloud temple and pine platform
the exact sword-fight choreography and final low stances

instantiations.concept: Inside an original wind-tunnel laboratory, two clockwork kite technicians at different platform depths alternately catch and redirect one fabric calibration ring at rising heights, stabilize it together at the ceiling apex, then land on opposite marked platforms with the ring suspended between them.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Two original clockwork kite technicians use a shared fabric calibration ring to build a low-to-high contact ladder inside a wind tunnel, culminating in one joint ceiling apex and a grounded two-platform hold.

instantiations.concept: In a flooded botanical dome, two amphibious maintenance drones begin at different water levels and alternately tap one floating sensor buoy up a sequence of spillway ledges; they meet above the top cascade to stabilize it, then settle on separate banks while the buoy remains centered.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Two original amphibious maintenance drones raise one sensor buoy through staged water levels, share one aerial stabilization apex and finish on separate banks with no competition result.

failure_modes.failure: The two roles start tangled together.
failure_modes.repair: Show stable identities and a readable gap before the first shared action.

failure_modes.failure: The first contact is already maximal.
failure_modes.repair: Begin with one low baseline contact so later states can visibly rise.

failure_modes.failure: Repeated events stay at one height.
failure_modes.repair: Assign each exchange a higher contact level or larger shared amplitude.

failure_modes.failure: Several equal aerial peaks compete for attention.
failure_modes.repair: Reserve one unmistakably highest joint event.

failure_modes.failure: The ending invents a winner or skips the return.
failure_modes.repair: Return both roles to the baseline plane and hold a neutral post-apex relationship.
